text_block_list.text:
And Сайленс Судзука dominates the track!
Just
wow! Сайленс Судзука comes out on
top of this
race between generational
talents!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What a race! Сайленс Судзука blew right
through
everyone!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
She's even faster than she was in the
Takarazuka
Kinen, right?!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер and Эль Кондор Паса were
great
too, But Suzuka was just something
else!
text_block_list.name: Spectator C

text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh! Rayos! I can't believe it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I ran at full speed! Am I slow or
something?! Why
couldn't I catch up?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Argh, I'll get you next time, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So you better not lose your edge! I have
to be the
one who beats the
Otherworldly Front-Runner!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka... We'll face each other on the
track again
someday!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Arrrgh! I can't get the word "slow" out of
my head!
Maldición!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Don't be like that, El...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It seems the excitement of today's
intense
competition will take a while to
settle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I surprised myself out there.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The way I ran, it was like I wasn't myself.
I felt as
though I could fly off.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Um...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me to continue
running like
this?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yes.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I guess you're right. It's fine, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm sorry. I must sound strange.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me! Where's Spe?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
H-hey! Sorry I left without saying
anything...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It's okay. More importantly... Are you
doing all
right? I heard you were feeling
down.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! Um...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Did something happen?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Urk... Well...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You know, watching both El and Grass
giving
their all to beat you...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: It made me super jealous.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be down there so bad, I was
tingling
all over.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Spe...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I've never felt this way watching you
race before!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It seems she's been infected by El
Condor Pasa's
and Грасс Вандер's
desire to beat Silence
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's no longer satisfied with only
catching up to
Сайленс Судзука. The fire
to surpass her has been
lit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Does that mean...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I'm like a guiding light to you?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: A... guiding light?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Спешл Уик's face slowly brightens.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yeah! That sounds about right!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yeah, that's totally what it is!
What a
relief!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Well, I was worried these feelings were
bad.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Not at all, Spe. I'm happy you feel that
way about
me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука's smile proves to be
infectious, as
Спешл Уик breaks into
one of her own.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ehehe!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do my best to keep you in
second
place, though.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa! I dunno if I'm ready to
challenge
you yet!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The Mainichi Okan has truly sparked the
passion
of many Umamusume today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With Сайленс Судзука reigning victorious,
she turns
toward her next objective...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The long-awaited autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
